llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹4,000 for funeral expenses and an ex‑gratia payment of ₹71,000 to the nominee of a deceased registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker), at least 18 years old, have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a year, and be the nominee of a deceased registered construction worker under the Board.
